tool.name: ESMFold
tool.description: predict a protein structure from a single FASTA sequence
tool.command: #set $execution_mode_arg = "" #if $execution_mode.mode == "cpu_only": #set $execution_mode_arg = "--cpu-only" #elif $execution_mode.mode == "cpu_offload": #set $execution_mode_arg = "--cpu-offload" #end if #set $max_tokens_arg = "" #if $advanced.max_tokens_per_batch.mode == "custom": #set $max_tokens_arg = "--max-tokens-per-batch '%s'" % $advanced.max_tokens_per_batch.value #end if #set $chunk_size_arg = "" #if $advanced.chunk_size.mode == "custom": #set $chunk_size_arg = "--chunk-size '%s'" % $advanced.chunk_size.value #end if #set $output_name_arg = "" #if str($advanced.output_name) not in ["", "None"]: #set $output_name_arg = "--output-name '%s'" % $advanced.output_name #end if #set $esmfold_command_arg = "" #if str($esmfold_command) not in ["", "None"]: #set $esmfold_command_arg = "--esmfold-command '%s'" % $esmfold_command #end if python '$__tool_directory__/run_esmfold.py' --input-fasta '$sequence' --output-pdb 'result.pdb' --summary-json 'summary.json' $esmfold_command_arg --num-recycles '$num_recycles' $execution_mode_arg $max_tokens_arg $chunk_size_arg $output_name_arg

param.name: sequence
param.label: Protein sequence (single FASTA record)
param.help: Use one protein or one multimer definition per dataset. For batches, map this tool over a collection instead of supplying a multi-record FASTA.

param.name: value
param.label: Custom max tokens per batch
param.help: Use this only when you need to limit batching for memory reasons.

param.name: value
param.label: Custom chunk size
param.help: Lower values reduce memory pressure but make inference slower.

param.name: output_name
param.label: Output name prefix
param.help: Defaults to the sanitized FASTA identifier.

tool.help:
ESMFold predicts a protein structure from a single FASTA record and returns:
- a ``PDB`` structure model - a small ``JSON`` summary containing sequence length, atom count, chain ids, and mean B-factor
The wrapper intentionally accepts **one FASTA record per dataset**. If you need to process many sequences, upload them as a collection and map this tool over the collection.
Admin notes ===========
This first wrapper targets the official ``esm-fold`` CLI from the `Meta ESM repository <https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm>`_. The Galaxy job environment must make that CLI available on ``PATH`` or override it with the ``ESMFOLD_BINARY`` environment variable. GPU execution is recommended for real workloads.
The wrapper also recognizes ``mock-esmfold`` as a lightweight built-in test mode for local wrapper verification and Galaxy tool tests. That mode is only intended for smoke tests, not for real structure prediction.
This repository already maps ``pdb`` datasets to the built-in ``Mol*`` visualization, so successful outputs can be opened directly in Galaxy's structure viewer.
